root_cause.text: The RSI911x driver fails to initialize `hw->vif_data_size` to the size of `struct vif_priv`, resulting in insufficient memory allocation for the virtual interface trailing space and subsequent out-of-bounds writes when the driver accesses `vif->drv_priv`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `hw->vif_data_size = sizeof(struct vif_priv);` in `rsi_mac80211_attach()`, and the CVE description states that "The RSI911x driver does not set vif driver data size, no trailing space for vif driver data is therefore allocated past struct ieee80211_vif" which "leads to access out of struct ieee80211_vif bounds and corruption of some memory" when the driver accesses `vif->drv_priv`.
